method: Current read-only frontend served locally and captured with Playwright at 1600 x 1000; converted to WebP with Sharp. 800 px derivatives support responsive delivery.

screens.login: Real login interface with empty input values; no authentication performed.
screens.dashboard: Real dashboard renderer supplied with explicit synthetic local data; no client names, phone numbers or production session used.
screens.gerencial: Real management renderer supplied with synthetic totals. Unintegrated channels remain marked unavailable; historical series remain empty.
screens.exportacao: Real export form; no export or download executed against a backend.
screens.meta: Existing local preview=meta mode and its demonstrative payload. Final production data source remains unintegrated.
screens.cover: Playwright capture of a staged HTML composition using the dashboard and Meta captures above. Perspective, lighting and overlap are presentation treatments, not replacement interfaces.

restrictions: No backend deployment, production data, credentials, database, spreadsheets, scrapers or synchronization changed or accessed. Numbers do not establish operational performance.
